descriptionChirho: The skill, technique, or product of artisan labor — handiwork, manufacture, the way something is made (Arabic صَنْعَة, Korean 솜씨/작품, Hindi कारीगरी/बनावट).
A human action or behavior, especially as subject to moral evaluation — deeds, acts, doings (Arabic عَمَل/فِعْل/أَعْمَال, Korean 행위, Swahili matendo).
The activity of working, a task or undertaking, one's occupation or business — work in the general sense of effort or employment (Arabic عَمَل as labor, Korean 일, Swahili kazi).
The mighty acts, creation, or deeds of God — used in theological and doxological contexts addressing or describing divine activity (Korean 주의 업적들/행하신 일들, Arabic أَعْمَال in divine reference).
The concrete result or output of labor — a product, produce, or thing made, emphasizing the result rather than the process (Korean 소출, Arabic المصنوع/صَنَائِع).
A matter, affair, or situation requiring attention — an event or thing in the general sense (Korean 사건, Swahili jambo).
